signature.instructions:
Produce a Blueprint-aligned API example for the given repository scenario.

Follow the NIAID Blueprint for Digital Objects. Include:
  * machine-readable dataset metadata as schema.org JSON-LD
  * an OpenAPI description of the access endpoint(s) the scenario needs
  * persistent identifiers where they apply
Ground the example in the scenario (domain, data type, access pattern).
Prefer real, well-formed fenced code blocks over placeholders or generic
templates. Keep the answer focused — metadata + API, not a long essay.

fields.description: The repository / API scenario to produce a Blueprint-aligned example for.
JSON-LD metadata block and OpenAPI snippet (fenced code), briefly explained.
